info.title: ReClaim AI API
info.summary: The HTTP surface of the ReClaim AI lost and found platform
info.description:
This document is the contract. Client and server disagreeing about a field name or an enum value is the direct cause of four defects in this project's register, which is why it exists (ARCH-19).

Every path below is served under `/api/v1`. The unversioned `/api` prefix is the same router, kept for callers written before the version existed; it answers identically and marks its responses `Deprecation: true`.

Authentication is a Firebase ID token in `Authorization: Bearer`. The caller's role is resolved from Firestore on every request, never read from the token or the body. Four endpoints are deliberately public: the item list and one item, and the two handover endpoints the finder uses, because the finder holds a link and a code rather than an account.

post.description: Fills the report form from the photos. Rate limited on its own budget.
Rewrites the reporter's text into something searchable.

get.description: Reports availability without revealing a key.

post.description: Fires once per successful sign-in, which is why it has its own limiter rather than the credential one.

post.summary: Create or refresh the caller's profile
post.description: The only route that creates `users/{uid}`. Runs on every app mount. Role, status and credits are server-set; the body may carry display fields only, and they are dropped rather than rejected when they do not fit. A 403 means the account is blocked.
Frames are sampled in the browser, not decoded here.

get.description: Returns 503 with a hint when the vision service is unreachable, because an empty list would read as a working detector that knows nothing.

post.description: Turns a detection into the text a found-item report needs.
Proxies the Flask service, which refuses every request without the shared token. Has its own scan limiter so the live tab does not exhaust the AI budget.

get.description: Own history, or any if the caller is an admin. Newest first, capped at 50.
Own balance, or any if the caller is an admin.

put.description: A delta, not a target. Writes a ledger entry with the reason and is deliberately not idempotent: the same adjustment twice is two events.

post.description: The only way back from a session blocked by three wrong attempts: the code is hashed, so the old one cannot be looked up. Clears the attempt budget and is recorded in the handover audit trail.

200.description: A new code was issued and emailed

get.description: Open, blocked and expired sessions. The code hash is deliberately absent from the response.
Public. A 404 means the link is dead, which the page must tell apart from a failure. Mounted at both `/handover` and `/handovers`. The two paths answer identically.

parameters.name: matchId
parameters.description: Match id, which is the session id

get.description: Own handovers, or any if the caller is an admin. Served by an `array-contains` query on `participantIds` once the backfill has run.

post.description: Public by design: the finder holds a link and a code, not an account. A wrong code is a 200 with `success: false` and the attempts left, so a rate limit or an outage is never reported as a wrong code. Mounted at both `/handover` and `/handovers`. The two paths answer identically.

get.description: Cursor paginated. A non-admin caller sees approved items only, whatever `moderation` asks for. Public: the browse list is readable signed out.

parameters.name: reportedBy
parameters.description: Owner uid. Own reports, or admin

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Id of the last item on the previous page

post.description: Creates the report and returns before matching runs, so a provider failure cannot fail a saved item. A user report starts unmoderated and is invisible until an admin approves it.

get.description: Own reports, or any if the caller is an admin.
An unapproved or rejected item is visible only to its reporter and to admins.

400.description: `/items/user` matches this pattern first and is handed back to `/items/user/{userId}`

put.description: Owner or admin. `status`, `type` and `matchScore` are admin only and are dropped for anyone else. Every server-owned field is unreachable here.

delete.description: Owner or admin. Also removes the images from Cloudinary.

get.description: Every admin decision recorded against this item.

post.description: The moderation gate. Approval is what starts matching; a rejection needs a reason, which is what the audit trail records.

200.description: The decision, and whether matching started

post.description: Re-runs the pipeline for one approved item.

put.description: Admin override of the match state.

get.description: Includes completed ones, so a dashboard keeps counting a handover after its match is archived. Each carries `isActive`.

post.description: Accepting opens the handover and emails both parties. Rejecting resets both halves of the pair to Pending, and charges the false-claim penalty only when the admin ticks it and the named user is part of the pair.

get.description: Feature flags, the AI provider and the map centre. Readable by any signed-in user because the client needs the flags.
The handful of flags a signed-out page needs. Falls back to defaults rather than failing.

post.description: The target account always comes from the token.
Fire and forget from the landing page.

get.description: One request per refresh. Counts come from aggregation queries and the lists from field-masked reads, so the browser never pulls a collection.
Cursor paginated. The browser cannot enumerate the collection directly.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Uid of the last row on the previous page

put.description: A blocked account is signed out with a visible reason on its next request.

firebaseIdToken.description: A Firebase ID token. The role is resolved server side

AiStatus.description: Availability only. No key or provider name is returned

keyframes.description: Frames the detector kept, passed through from the vision service

CctvClasses.description: Passed through from the vision service unchanged

CctvDescribeResult.description: The model's answer, or a placeholder built from the detected class when it gave nothing usable

CctvDetectResult.description: Passed through from the vision service unchanged, so its shape is the Flask contract rather than this one

DashboardStats.description: Counts from aggregation queries, lists from field-masked reads. One request per refresh

totalHandovers.description: All time, not the windowed trend above

heatmapPoints.description: Just enough of an item to place and label a marker

error.description: The message. A deliberate 4xx keeps its own text; a 5xx is sanitized in production

details.description: Field errors on a validation failure

criteriaFailure.description: On a 400: which handover check refused

HandoverSession.description: An open, blocked or expired session. The code hash is never included

moderation.description: Absent on items that predate review, which read as approved

ItemAnalysis.description: What both AI endpoints answer. Placeholder values when the model gave nothing usable

collectionLocation.description: Alias for collectionPoint, mapped on write

items.description: Base64 data URL or an existing URL

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page. Null on the last page

updates.description: Only these fields may change. status, type and matchScore are admin only

cloudinaryUrls.description: Removal only. A URL not already on the item is rejected

claimUserId.description: Required only when penaliseClaimant is true

overrideCriteria.description: Proceed despite the distance, day and time checks failing

penaliseClaimant.description: Charge the false-claim penalty on a rejection

criteriaFailure.description: On a 400: which handover check refused, so the admin can override it

MatchingOutcome.description: `pending` matching was started, `awaiting_review` the item needs approval first, `not_started` there was nothing to match on

ModeResponse.description: Public. Falls back to defaults rather than failing

dailyLimit.description: The testing-mode call budget, null when off

created.description: True on the 201. The route is called on every app mount

availableProviders.description: Which providers have a key configured. Availability only

Timestamp.description: A Firestore timestamp as it survives JSON

UserHandovers.description: Note the key: this endpoint answers `handovers`, the admin history answers `history`

UserPage.description: Admin accounts are filtered out of the list

attemptsLeft.description: Present on a wrong code. Absent once the session is blocked, which the message says

ValidationError.description: The request failed validation. `details` names the fields

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted, or the account is blocked

RateLimited.description: Rate limit exceeded for this surface

BadGateway.description: The vision service refused or failed
